name: Reduce Signup Friction
summary: Reduce account-creation friction while preserving security, consent, accessibility, and recovery.
description: Review and improve signup, registration, account creation, or trial entry across intent, fields, identity, security, consent, errors, verification, and continuation. Use when prospective users abandon before entering the product.
risk_reason: This skill reduces account-creation friction while preserving security, consent, accessibility, and recovery; it does not claim conversion improvement from static review alone.
refuses: It does not remove security or consent controls solely to increase completion.
It does not preselect marketing consent, hide terms, or create accounts without clear user action.
It does not claim conversion improvement from static review alone.

operational.latency_reason: The skill reduces account-creation friction while preserving security, consent, accessibility, and recovery, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
